bzip2.env.description: Environment variable configuration for bzip2 command-line defaults (BZIP2 > BZIP). Each list entry is a space-separated list of options to be prepended to CLI args in that order of precedence. Values should be raw strings of CLI flags/options (e.g., '-s -k'). The environment variables are used only at runtime (e.g., in shell profiles or service wrappers); bzip2 itself does not have a config file. This section reflects real documented behavior from the man page: "bzip2 will read arguments from the environment variables BZIP2 and BZIP, in that order, and will process them before any arguments read from the command line." No other config file exists for bzip2. We model them as optional list-of-strings to support multi-option defaults, matching shell quoting semantics. Only the variables documented in man 1 bzip2 are used here.

bzip2.env.BZIP2.description: List of bzip2 options for the BZIP2 environment variable (higher precedence). Each item is a list of flags as a single string, e.g., ['-s', '-k']. Used when compressing or decompressing. See man bzip2(1) under ENVIRONMENT. Example: ['-s'] or ['-5', '-k'].

bzip2.env.BZIP.description: List of bzip2 options for the BZIP environment variable (lower precedence than BZIP2). Same format as BZIP2.
